_about: Project sound palette for ios-smooth-act1 (sound redesign, 26 Nov 2026). Real-action / foley designs only - every role is a thing that visibly happens on screen (glass, counter wheels, stamps, chips seating, a cartridge on a rail, air for camera travel). No chimes, bells, zaps, game bleeps or boom-on-everything. earshot ranks the candidates against `want`; `real_weight` adds earshot's realness score so recorded-sounding designs win; `pick` = chosen after listening to describe/match. `post` trims and filters the take (soft tops, short tails).

glass_tap.want: a fingertip tapping softly on the glass screen of a phone
glass_tap.why: a fingertip on a phone is a dull soft touch, not a UI click

glass_swipe.want: a finger swiping across a glass phone screen, soft and short
glass_swipe.why: skin dragging over glass: soft cloth-like friction, no whoosh

peel.want: a few cards fanned apart with a quick soft flutter of paper
peel.why: thin frames fanning out = paper flutter, light and dry

ratchet.want: one small dry mechanical click of a counter wheel turning one notch
ratchet.why: the counters are drawn as mechanical drum odometers, so they click like one: small dry notches that slow as the number lands

lock.want: a number wheel locking into place with a short soft low clunk
lock.why: the last wheel stopping: one short low latch closes the count (also used, pitched up and quieter, for small things clicking into place)

stamp.want: a rubber stamp pressed down onto paper on a desk, a muted thud
stamp.why: rubber stamp on paper: a muted thud, the film's few true accents (LATE, HITCH, the signed deal)

seat.want: a chip pressed into its socket: a short soft low thud with a small click
seat.why: a chip pressed into its socket: one low soft thud - low end only on real impacts

set.want: a small object set down gently on a stand, soft and low
set.why: a small object put down on a stand: a flat quiet thud, sized to the object

pulse.want: a single low soft heartbeat thump, felt more than heard
pulse.why: "your thumb can feel it": a single heartbeat-like thump, felt more than heard

air_short.want: a short soft breath of air as a camera moves past
air_short.why: small camera / lid movement: a breath of air, not a designed whoosh

air_long.want: a long soft rush of air passing as the camera dives forward
air_long.why: long camera travel (dive, tunnel, hero push): one soft low rush of air shaped to the move

hum_on.want: a soft low electrical hum fading in as a circuit powers on
hum_on.why: current starting to flow: a soft mains-like hum fading in (no zap, no power-up chime)

switch.why: the instant something turns on: one small real switch click

slide.want: a small cartridge sliding along a rail and stopping softly
slide.why: the glass cartridge riding its rail: a short low slide ending in a soft stop

knock_dull.want: a dull muted knock, something stuck
knock_dull.why: something stuck or shut: a dull wooden knock, no error buzzer

clock_tick.want: one small dry tick of a clock
clock_tick.why: "on the very next tick": a real stopwatch tick; three in a row = the server keeps time

hollow.want: a soft hollow knock on an empty box
hollow.why: the empty socket: a hollow knock - there is nothing inside

node_ticks.want: a quick run of tiny soft ticks, like small lights switching on one by one
node_ticks.why: many tiny things lighting one after another: a faint run of ticks under the voice

glass_lift.want: a glass panel lifted off a phone with a soft release of air
glass_lift.why: the back glass coming off: a soft puff of released air

air_pass.want: a soft rush of air passing from one side to the other as the camera travels
air_pass.why: camera travelling sideways along the set: air passing from one side to the other
